name: turno-monorepo
description: Switch accounts in your coding agents and keep the conversation, the MCP sign-ins and the browser session.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs bench/browser/*.test.mjs && node scripts/no-em-dash.mjs && node scripts/patchright-guard.mjs && node scripts/licenses.mjs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-server-json.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm pack:check && changeset publish
scripts.docs:check: pnpm --filter turno-docs run generate:check && pnpm --filter turno-docs run build && pnpm --filter turno-docs run links
